sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Type / MCQs / True-False

questions.question_text: Which of the following terms refers to contracting a specific business task, such as customer support, to a third-party service provider?
In touch typing, the keys A, S, D, F, J, K, L, and ; are collectively known as which of the following?
Which keyboard shortcut is universally used to copy selected text in a digital document?
State whether True or False: Medical transcription is a prominent example of Information Technology enabled Services (ITeS).
Which property in a digital word processor controls whether the page layout is printed horizontally or vertically?
Which two keys on a standard QWERTY keyboard contain small raised bumps to help typists position their fingers without looking?
When text is formatted so that it is flush with both the left and right margins, what type of alignment is applied?
State whether True or False: The 'Word Wrap' feature automatically moves the text to the next line when it reaches the right margin.
Which feature is used to apply a specific predefined formatting style—including font size, color, and weight—to multiple text selections simultaneously?
What are the text blocks placed at the very top and very bottom margins of a document called, often used for page numbers and titles?
Define the term BPO (Business Process Outsourcing) in the context of the ITeS industry. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: BPO stands for Business Process Outsourcing. It involves contracting non-primary business activities and functions to a third-party service provider to reduce costs and improve overall efficiency.

questions.question_text: Explain the purpose of the Home Row keys in touch typing. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The Home Row refers to the middle row of keys where fingers naturally rest during touch typing, allowing rapid, blind access to all other surrounding keyboard keys.

questions.question_text: Differentiate between the 'Save' and 'Save As' commands in a digital word processor. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: 'Save' updates the current document with recent changes, while 'Save As' allows the user to save a brand new copy of the document with a different name or location.

questions.question_text: What are guide keys on a computer keyboard, and what is their specific function? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The keys 'F' and 'J' are guide keys. They feature small tactile bumps that help typists position their index fingers on the home row without looking at the keyboard.

questions.question_text: Explain what is meant by 'text alignment' in digital documentation. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Text alignment dictates how text is positioned between the left and right document margins. Common types include left, right, center, and justified, which help structure the visual layout cleanly.

questions.question_text: List the sequential steps required to apply a bulleted list format to selected text within a digital word processing document. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: First, highlight the text you wish to format. Next, navigate to the Home tab on the ribbon, locate the Paragraph group, and click the Bullets icon to automatically apply standard bullet points to the selected list.

questions.question_text: Discuss any two major applications of Information Technology enabled Services (ITeS) within the modern healthcare sector. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: ITeS heavily supports the healthcare industry through electronic medical records management and medical transcription. These services ensure patient data is accurately digitized, stored securely, and easily accessible to authorized medical professionals globally.

questions.question_text: Read the following case context: A student complains of severe wrist pain and poor typing speed after long data entry sessions. Outline the correct ergonomic posture and hand placement rules they must adopt to improve mechanics. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The student must sit perfectly straight with feet completely flat on the floor and the monitor directly at eye level. Wrists should remain straight, relaxed, and floating, rather than resting heavily on the keyboard edge. Fingers must curve gently over the home row to maximize typing speed and eliminate strain.

questions.question_text: Read the following case context: A user needs to design a structured, professional multi-page report in a word processor. Describe the step-by-step tools they should use to apply page borders, modify line spacing, and insert an automatic table of contents. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: To design the report, the user should navigate to the Design tab to select and apply custom Page Borders. Then, highlight the text and use the Paragraph settings to adjust line spacing. Finally, assign consistent Heading styles to text and use the References tab to automatically insert a Table of Contents.
